selection_basis: OpenBao and Infisical both passed the complete frozen 20-step Stage A fixture.
OpenBao is the tighter fit for the narrow credential-broker role and passed with a single lightweight service in the tested path.
OpenBao completed the fixture in 5 seconds with about 27 MiB observed memory.
Infisical completed the fixture in 71 seconds and required application, PostgreSQL and Redis services, so it is retained as fallback rather than rejected.
next_gate: Complete the identity lane disposition, then execute the shared cross-role composition fixture. No production authority before later promotion gates.
